description: Put saved tests in a regular test category, with their runs and the schedules that run them. Red team and bias tests are skipped and counted: their category is their type.

category.description: The category's id or name, as list_test_categories shows them.
category.title: Category

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

tests.description: The saved test ids to put in it, as list_tests shows them.
tests.title: Tests

name: move_tests_to_category
